description.zh: 要模糊查询的防护资产API。
description.en: The API of the protected asset to fuzzy match.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-500，默认值为500。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500.

description.zh: 下一页查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的**NextToken**参数值。首页查询无需传入。
description.en: The pagination token (Token) for the next page. Set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** returned in the previous API call. Leave this parameter empty for the first page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh: 要模糊查询的防护对象或防护组名称。
description.en: The name of the protected object or protected object group to fuzzy match.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

The type of the protected resource. Valid values:
- **single**: protected object.
- **asset**: protected asset.
- **group**: protected object group.
The ID of the protection template.

title.zh: 查询防护模板绑定的资源
title.en: Query resources bound to a protection template

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-template-resources --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 1020 --resource-type single --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --next-token AAAAAJ7ob70000000MhJJ1ELRE= --max-results 20 --resource abc.test.com-waf --asset-api abc.com --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeTemplateResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --AssetApi 'abc.com' --NextToken 'AAAAAJ7ob70000000MhJJ1ELRE=' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --MaxResults 20 --Resource 'abc.test.com-waf' --ResourceType single --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TemplateId 1020
